entities.name: Banana Wars and Economic Challenges
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The World Trade Organization's rulings against the EU's preferential banana import regime in the 1990s threatened to devastate the Saint Lucian economy, which depended heavily on banana exports. The 'Banana Wars' trade dispute forced painful economic restructuring and diversification toward tourism.
